description: Reset a broken service by deleting its Cloud Run or Vercel resource. Recovery tool for when a container is stuck on a broken revision (e.g., updateService returns 422 on every deploy). For a registered App the Cloud Run service is created again at once from the build that served, with its env vars and scaling (a Vercel App has nothing to reset); for other projects the next deploy creates a fresh service. Database, env vars, and project config are all preserved. For multi-service projects, specify service_name to target a specific service.

service_name.description: Service name for multi-service projects. Omit for single-service.

name: reset_service
